chunks: And by this chain, he said:
He said: The one who mentions Allah, Mighty and Majestic, upon the meal would not be questioned about that Bounty, ever.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of mentioning Allah before eating according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith to highlight how mindful gratitude (shukr) during consumption transforms a mundane act into an act of worship, thereby exempting the believer from accountability for that specific blessing on the Day of Judgment. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the spiritual efficacy of dhikr in sanctifying daily sustenance and securing divine favor.
